description: LSSTCam is a 3.2-gigapixel optical survey camera with a 9.6-square-degree field of view and six filters, u, g, r, i, z and y, used for the Legacy Survey of Space and Time.
facility_description: The Simonyi Survey Telescope at NSF-DOE Vera C. Rubin Observatory carries LSSTCam for the Legacy Survey of Space and Time.
notes: Owner pages opened in this session: LSSTCam documentation, lsst/throughputs and lsst-pst/syseng_throughputs. No explicit curve redistribution licence was found there. Public GitHub visibility is not a licence; no software or documentation licence has been applied to curve data. Current LSSTCam documentation and repository revisions need not match the historical NJM profiles; no band-level reference or numerical metadata is asserted. The owner instrument page describes total throughput including atmosphere at airmass 1.2, optics and detector sensitivity. The acknowledgement entry is the owner-requested instrument citation string rather than a dataset acknowledgement.
